_doc: Inputs for analyze.py. See INVESTIGATORS_TEAM_EXPERIMENT_POWER_ANALYSIS_PLAYBOOK.md §3 and §7. Add each new fielding round to `eras` before running; analyze.py refuses rounds that are not listed here.
_eras_doc: Era = rounds whose AI build shares task budget, remark binding, request schedule and post-task instrument (PLAYBOOK §3.2). A: tp_ai_v3, 360 s, no remarks. B: tp_ai_v4/v6/v7, 300 s, remarks.tp_pressure@v1, pre-seat-plan schedule, post_task@v4. C: tp_ai_v11/v13, seat_plan schedule (5 inbound requests 45/100/155/210/245 s), post_task@v5 (tp_post_11). v10 and v11 differ only in practice-page gating (training v5 vs v6) and the bound open_ended stage.

h3_hypothetical._doc: Cell accuracies [arm, dependence] for a task with no floor problem. high-dep 0.35 (low arm) -> 0.20 (high arm) = interaction -0.15.
